intro: Turkmenistan holds some of the world's largest natural gas reserves.

chapters.title: Gas
text: The Galkynysh field is one of the largest gas fields on Earth. Most gas goes to China by pipeline.

chapters.title: Cotton
text: Cotton and wheat are the main crops, grown with canal water. Rights groups have criticised forced labour in the cotton harvest.

keyTerms.meaning: An area with natural gas underground.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Turkmenistan makes and sells to the world.
